paper.title: Optimally Confident UCB: Improved Regret for Finite-Armed Bandits

unmapped: noise is 1-subgaussian (sigma = 1) and may depend on the chosen arm
settings.definition_quote: In each time step $t$ the learner chooses an action $I_t \in \set{1,\ldots,K}$ and receives a reward $\mu_{I_t} + \eta_t$ where $\mu_i$ is the unknown expected reward of arm $i$ and the noise term $\eta_t$ is sampled from some $1$-subgaussian distribution that may depend on $I_t$.

unmapped: instances mu^i with mu_1 = Delta, mu_i = 2 Delta, others 0
settings.definition_quote: let $\Delta > 0$ and define $\mu^i \in \R^K$ ... $\mu^i_k = \Delta$ if $k = 1$, $2\Delta$ if $k = i$, $0$ otherwise. Let $\E_i$ denote the expectation with respect to the measure on outcomes induced by the combination of the fixed strategy with environment $\mu^i$ and standard Gaussian noise.

symbols.C_1: unspecified constant depending only on alpha and psi

source.label: thm:prob-dep
source.quote: If $\Delta_K \leq 1$ and $\alpha > 2$ and $\psi \geq 2$, then there exists a constant $C_1(\alpha, \psi)$ depending only on $\alpha$ and $\psi$ such that $R_\mu^{\text{ocucb}}(n) \leq \sum_{i=2}^K \frac{C_1(\alpha, \psi)}{\Delta_i} \logp \left(\frac{n}{H_i}\right)$, $H_i = \sum_{j=1}^K \min\set{\frac{1}{\Delta_i^2}, \frac{1}{\Delta_j^2}}$.

results.notes: logp(x)=max{1,log x}. Regret defined via means: pseudo-regret. Paper notes Delta_K<=1 can be dropped with additive O(sum Delta_i).

symbols.C_2: unspecified constant depending only on alpha and psi

source.label: thm:prob-ind
source.quote: If $\Delta_K \leq 1$ and $\alpha > 2$ and $\psi \geq 2$, then there exists a constant $C_2(\alpha, \psi)$ depending only on $\alpha$ and $\psi$ such that $\sup_\mu R_\mu^{\text{ocucb}}(n) \leq C_2(\alpha, \psi) \sqrt{nK}$.

conditions: bound holds for at least one of the instances mu^i (mu_1 = Delta, mu_i = 2 Delta, others 0)

source.label: thm:lower
source.quote: Assume $H = (K-1)/\Delta^2 \leq n/e$. Then there exists an $i$ such that $R^\pi_{\mu^i}(n) \geq \frac{1}{4} \cdot \frac{K-1}{\Delta} \log\left(\frac{n}{H}\right)$.

results.notes: Holds for any fixed policy pi; the bound is attained on one instance among a family of K instances with uniform gaps (Delta in mu^1). Not strictly instance-wise; it is a local minimax lower bound.

bound.regime: for all delta_thr >= 0; sum restricted to arms with Delta_i > delta_thr

symbols.delta_thr: arbitrary gap threshold delta >= 0 (paper's delta, not a failure probability)

source.label: thm:aocucb
source.quote: There exist universal constants $C_3$ and $C_4$ such that for all $\delta \geq 0$, $R_\mu^{\text{aocucb}}(n) \leq n\delta + \sum_{i: \Delta_i > \delta} \frac{C_3}{\Delta_i} \logp\left(n\Delta_i^2\right)$ and $R_\mu^{\text{aocucb}}(n) \leq C_4 \sqrt{nK \log K}$.

results.notes: sum_subopt in the expression should be read as restricted to arms with Delta_i > delta_thr. Proof is sketched.

source.label: thm:aocucb
source.quote: There exist universal constants $C_3$ and $C_4$ such that ... $R_\mu^{\text{aocucb}}(n) \leq C_4 \sqrt{nK \log K}$.

results.notes: Worst-case bound of the same theorem.
